summary: QA Gate 5b (CR-376-FU-B) frontend-only verification against preprod. Logged in as QA_HYATT (password masked as ***). Set active menu FOOD MENU via /visibility/status-config, opened Order Entry from a free table, and validated all V-checks. All V-checks PASS: default tab is 'All (86)' (V7), every category row's bracket count exactly equals rendered menu-item tiles (V8, 12/12 rows), no ghost (0) rows and only FOOD-MENU categories are shown (V8b), Popular row absent (V9 acceptable — see notes), menu switch to 'Bar & Drinks' changes the panel to 16 Bar & Drinks-only categories with All (170) and correct counts (V10), regression search+add-to-cart works (V11), no CategoryPanel/OrderEntry console errors (R5).

V7_default_tab_all.detail: category-all is the highlighted row on Order Entry mount. Label='All (86)' matches /^All \(\d+\)$/. Active state uses inline style backgroundColor=COLORS.primaryGreen (rgb(50,153,55)) — visually green in screenshot, and confirmed via computed style on V10 run.

V8b_no_ghost_categories.detail: Zero categories showing '(0)'. 12 category rows shown (incl. All). All 11 non-All categories map to FOOD MENU only — categories that live in Bar & Drinks/Breakfast/etc. are NOT rendered.

V9_popular_scoping.detail: data-testid category-popular is not rendered when FOOD MENU is active. Consistent with the CR-376-FU-B rule that Popular is hidden entirely when the popular ∩ active-menu intersection is empty, or when restaurant setting showPopularCategory is OFF. Could not disambiguate the exact reason from the client (setting is a backend flag), but no failure per acceptance criteria.

V10_menu_switch.detail: Switched active menu to 'Bar & Drinks' (via localStorage + hard reload). Chip shows 'Bar & Drinks Menu'. Category set completely changed to 16 Bar & Drinks-only rows (Cocktails, Beer, Gin, Breezers, Cognac, Single Malt, White Wine, Red Wine, Champagne & Sparkling Wine, Whisky/Bourbon, Rum, Vodka, Tequila & Agave, Liqueur & Aperitif, Sober Tales + All). Default tab is again All (170). Spot-check tile counts: All (170)=170, Cocktails (20)=20, Beer (9)=9, Gin (20)=20 — all match. computed backgroundColor of active row = rgb(50,153,55) (green).

V11_R1_regression_order_flow.detail: Typed 'chicken' in menu-search-input → tile count narrowed from 86 → 21. Cleared search. Clicked first tile (Fresh Fruit Platter.) — cart shows the item at ₹399 with qty 1, 'No items in order' placeholder is gone, Place Order button becomes active. Category-back-btn is present in the panel.

R5_console.detail: No console errors/warnings mentioning CategoryPanel, OrderEntry, 'count', 'undefined' or key collisions. Only unrelated infra warnings: Firebase notification permission denied, presocket.mygenie.online WebSocket close, [OrderPolling] aborted (mount-or-auth, 15000ms).

notes: Two potentially anomalous menu-option pills exist for the Hyatt restaurant: 'promational-menu' (typo?) and 'grok'. They are surfaced by data as-is; not part of this CR but worth flagging to product.

Note the chip text for Bar & Drinks reads 'Bar & Drinks Menu' (has a trailing 'Menu' suffix) while FOOD MENU chip reads 'FOOD MENU'. Chip label formatting is inconsistent between menu types — cosmetic only, not a CR-376-FU-B blocker.
critical_code_review_comments: CategoryPanel.jsx uses inline style backgroundColor for active row — automated tests cannot rely on className='bg-green-*'. Consider adding data-testid attribute variant or aria-selected to make active-row assertions cheaper.
Chip label formatting differs between menus ('FOOD MENU' vs 'Bar & Drinks Menu'). Consider unifying (either always append 'Menu' or never).

Two suspicious menu options 'grok' and 'promational-menu' appear alongside 'promotional-menu' — likely data-quality issues in the restaurant's menu list. Out of scope for CR-376-FU-B but should be reported to data/backend team.
test_credentials: QA_HYATT: owner@hyatt.com / *** (verified). Password masked per R20.
seed_data_creation: None. No orders were placed/settled on preprod (only added an item to the cart client-side, never submitted). localStorage key mygenie_active_menu_type toggled between 'FOOD MENU' and 'Bar & Drinks'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Order Entry navigation with QA_HYATT: (1) login using data-testid login-email/login-password + submit button; (2) wait 20-25s for boot (300+ products loading from preprod); (3) set active menu via localStorage.setItem('mygenie_active_menu_type','FOOD MENU') and reload — much more reliable than clicking through StatusConfig; (4) click any table-card-<id> from /dashboard; (5) category-panel + active-menu-type-chip render within ~4s. Active-row highlight uses inline style backgroundColor=rgb(50,153,55), NOT a class token — assert with computed style, not className. Popular row was absent for both FOOD MENU and Bar & Drinks — acceptable per spec.
rca of the issue: No issue observed for CR-376-FU-B. All acceptance criteria met on Hyatt (multi-menu) restaurant.
